svg.title: GDN paper Figure 2: length extrapolation on six long-context benchmarks
svg.desc: Perplexity from 4k to 20k tokens for seven 1.3B models (Mamba1, DeltaNet, Mamba2, Samba, Gated DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet-H1, Gated DeltaNet-H2) on GovReport, QMSum, NarrativeQA, Qasper, CodeParrot and PG19, transcribed from the coordinates in the paper TeX source.
svg.text: GDN 原论文 Figure 2：六个长上下文 benchmark 的困惑度
图例（1.3B 模型，训练长度 4K，评测 4k–20k）
